description: Updates properties of an existing container in a live Trident document. Only provided fields are changed. Use get_document_summary to get all container IDs before calling this. Requires a valid editor access token. This is also how you RESIZE a container: set width/height (and x/y to keep it centred over its nodes) — do this whenever you add or move nodes outside a fixed-size container.

action_explanation.description: Optional: brief explanation of what this action does and why (max 250 chars). Shown live to human collaborators in the AI cursor tooltip.

agentId.description: YOUR AI assistant name (e.g. "Claude.ai", "GitHub Copilot"). Shown as "[agentId] working with [userName]" in the collaboration presence dot.

height.description: Fixed height — enlarge so every member node fits (edges at y ± height/2)

width.description: Fixed width — enlarge so every member node fits (edges at x ± width/2)

containerId.description: ID of the container to update

token.description: Editor access token for this document. The document ID is embedded in the token.

userName.description: First name of the human you are assisting (ask them at session start if you do not know). Shown in the collaboration presence dot as "[agentId] working with [userName]".

name: update_container
